activities.whatToDo: Immigration, baggage claim, buy local Beeline/Tele2 SIM, order Yandex XL Taxi to hotel.
activities.mustTry: Local SIM card setup at arrivals
activities.lookOutFor: Ignore aggressive unlicensed airport taxi drivers; stick strictly to Yandex Go app

activities.whatToDo: Hotel check-in or drop luggage in storage.
activities.mustTry: Request early check-in or store bags
activities.lookOutFor: Keep passports handy

activities.whatToDo: Traditional Kazakh & Central Asian kick-off lunch.
activities.mustTry: Boshu Lagman (hand-pulled noodles) & Manti
activities.lookOutFor: Portion sizes are generous for sharing

activities.whatToDo: Explore historic market stalls, spices, meats, and dried fruits.
activities.mustTry: Kurt (salted cheese balls), local mountain honey, dried apricots
activities.lookOutFor: Closed on Mondays! Cash only for stall vendors

activities.whatToDo: Walk through leafy park and visit the famous 19th-century wooden cathedral built without nails.
activities.mustTry: Intricate wooden architecture photo spots
activities.lookOutFor: Modest dress code inside cathedral

activities.whatToDo: Evening promenade, street musicians, local art galleries.
activities.mustTry: Street performances & artisan crafts
activities.lookOutFor: Watch out for cyclists on pedestrian paths

activities.whatToDo: Dinner & Craft drinks / Georgian feast.
activities.mustTry: Shashlik, Khachapuri or local craft beer at Harat's
activities.lookOutFor: Card payments widely accepted in Almaty city

activities.whatToDo: Breakfast and specialty coffee.
activities.mustTry: Syrniki (cottage cheese pancakes) with berry jam
activities.lookOutFor: Top up Onay bus card or keep contactless bank card ready

activities.whatToDo: Ride public Bus No. 12 from Dostyk Ave (~40 mins) to Medeu valley.
activities.mustTry: Panoramas of highest ice rink in the world
activities.lookOutFor: Bus can get crowded on pleasant mornings

activities.whatToDo: Ride 3-stage cable car up to Talgar Pass for high mountain peaks.
activities.mustTry: Chalet dining at 3200 Cafe, crisp glacier air
activities.lookOutFor: Temperatures are 10°C colder than city; wear extra thermal layer

activities.whatToDo: Take bus or Yandex Taxi back down Dostyk Avenue.
activities.mustTry: Rest legs on transit
activities.lookOutFor: Afternoon traffic peaks around 17:30

activities.whatToDo: Aerial cable car from Dostyk Ave to Kok Tobe park for sunset over Almaty.
activities.mustTry: Almaty Tower view & sunset photos
activities.lookOutFor: Cable car ticket ~1,250 KZT roundtrip

activities.whatToDo: Dinner and drinks.
activities.mustTry: Traditional Kazakh Beshbarmak noodle plate
activities.lookOutFor: Hydrate well after altitude

activities.whatToDo: Take Yandex Taxi to hydro-station barrier; walk final scenic section up to alpine reservoir.
activities.mustTry: Turquoise mountain mirror lake reflections
activities.lookOutFor: MANDATORY: Carry original passports (border patrol zone near Kyrgyzstan)

activities.whatToDo: Descend to riverside restaurants in Almarasan canyon.
activities.mustTry: Freshly grilled mountain trout & lamb shashlik
activities.lookOutFor: Check trout price per 100 grams before ordering

activities.whatToDo: Historic Soviet/Kazakh public bathhouse recovery session.
activities.mustTry: Venik (oak leaf bundle) sauna massage & cold plunge pool
activities.lookOutFor: Gender-segregated; bring rubber slippers and towel

activities.whatToDo: Relaxed city dinner.
activities.mustTry: Kazakh horse meat delicacies (Kazy) or Georgian wine
activities.lookOutFor: Early night before early morning tour

activities.whatToDo: Board 4x4 tour vehicle from hotel; drive through Turgen mountain river gorge.
activities.mustTry: Bear Waterfall walk
activities.lookOutFor: Tour operator drives extreme riverbed off-road sections

activities.whatToDo: Explore vast high-altitude steppe (2700m), rivers, nomads, and lone Soviet observatory dome.
activities.mustTry: Nomadic yurt photo ops & outdoor group picnic
activities.lookOutFor: Zero cellular network on plateau; pack thermal jacket

activities.whatToDo: Scenic descent back down Turgen valley to city.
activities.mustTry: Mountain honey roadside stalls
activities.lookOutFor: Keep camera ready for wild horse herds

activities.whatToDo: Hotel drop-off; evening dinner in Almaty.
activities.mustTry: Craft burger or Italian dinner at Parmigiano
activities.lookOutFor: Rest well before 3-day road trip tomorrow

activities.whatToDo: Pick up 3-day rental minivan/crossover. Leave main suitcases at Almaty hotel storage.
activities.mustTry: Inspect rental vehicle tires, spare tire, & jack carefully
activities.lookOutFor: Ensure driver has International Driving Permit (IDP)

activities.whatToDo: Drive ~200 km to Charyn Canyon entrance. Stop at Baiseit village market.
activities.mustTry: Fresh hot Tandir Samsa at Baiseit roadside stall
activities.lookOutFor: Observe speed limits (50 km/h in villages, traffic police enforce with radar)

activities.whatToDo: Hike 2.5 km down dramatic red rock canyon gorge down to Charyn River.
activities.mustTry: Eco-bus option back uphill if exhausted
activities.lookOutFor: Intense midday heat; entry fee ~850 KZT/person; carry minimum 2L water

activities.whatToDo: 20-min photo stop directly along main highway overlook.
activities.mustTry: Sheer vertical canyon cliff view down to rushing river
activities.lookOutFor: No barrier edge; stay safe while taking photos

activities.whatToDo: Arrive at Saty family guesthouse. Check-in and enjoy hearty homemade dinner.
activities.mustTry: Baursak (fried dough), fresh sheep/cow cheese, hot mountain tea
activities.lookOutFor: Cash only in Saty village (KZT); no ATM or card readers

activities.whatToDo: Guesthouse home breakfast.
activities.mustTry: Fresh farm eggs, homemade berry jams
activities.lookOutFor: Pack warm windbreaker jacket

activities.whatToDo: Hire local Soviet UAZ 4x4 Bukhanka van from Saty. Hike/horse ride to submerged birch tree forest lake.
activities.mustTry: Spruce trees standing upright in turquoise water
activities.lookOutFor: DO NOT drive rental car here (riverbed tracks break standard cars). Eco-fee ~850 KZT

activities.whatToDo: Return to village for hot guesthouse lunch.
activities.mustTry: Traditional Lagman or Kuurdak
activities.lookOutFor: Rest up before afternoon lake stroll

activities.whatToDo: Drive 20 mins on smooth asphalt road to Lower Kolsai Lake.
activities.mustTry: Wooden rowboat rental on turquoise alpine lake
activities.lookOutFor: Rowboat ~5000 KZT / 30 mins; late afternoon golden hour lighting

activities.whatToDo: Dinner and stargazing in guesthouse courtyard.
activities.mustTry: Unpolluted mountain night sky views
activities.lookOutFor: Night temps drop fast

activities.whatToDo: Early check-out & drive 250 km via Chilik and Kokpek pass to Basshi village.
activities.mustTry: Scenic steppe landscapes
activities.lookOutFor: Start early to avoid navigating unlit dirt tracks at night

activities.whatToDo: Register vehicle and pay entry tickets at Altyn Emel National Park headquarters.
activities.mustTry: Local village lunch at Basshi
activities.lookOutFor: Keep park permit receipt visible on car dashboard

activities.whatToDo: Drive 1-hour washboard gravel track to Singing Dunes. Climb dune ridge and slide down.
activities.mustTry: Hear the loud organ-like hum produced by vibrating sand
activities.lookOutFor: Cap driving speed at 40 km/h on gravel; wear sunglasses, hat, and sunscreen

activities.whatToDo: Check-in to local Basshi guesthouse. Dinner and rest.
activities.mustTry: Homestyle Kazakh nomadic hospitality
activities.lookOutFor: Cash for guesthouse stay

activities.whatToDo: Drive 255 km back to Almaty via Qonaev (Kapchagay) toll highway.
activities.mustTry: Lake Kapchagay view along highway
activities.lookOutFor: Refuel at Qazaq Oil or Compass gas station near highway

activities.whatToDo: Return rental car (clean interior, full fuel tank).
activities.mustTry: Retrieve stored main suitcases from hotel
activities.lookOutFor: Rental drop-off inspection

activities.whatToDo: Lunch along pedestrian avenue.
activities.mustTry: Craft coffee & Central Asian baked pastries
activities.lookOutFor: Relaxed urban vibe

activities.whatToDo: Explore Kazakh nomadic history and archaeological treasures.
activities.mustTry: Golden Man (Altyn Adam) ancient warrior exhibit
activities.lookOutFor: Museum ticket ~1,000 KZT

activities.whatToDo: Souvenir shopping at official factory outlet on Zenkov Street.
activities.mustTry: Signature blue-wrapped "Kazakhstan" chocolate bars and tins
activities.lookOutFor: Factory store offers best wholesale prices

activities.whatToDo: Final celebratory dinner in Almaty.
activities.mustTry: Gosti or Kishlak farewell feast
activities.lookOutFor: Allow 45 mins transit time to airport

activities.whatToDo: Yandex XL Taxi to airport; check-in 3 hours prior to departure.
activities.mustTry: Safe journey home!
activities.lookOutFor: Ensure no liquids or souvenirs exceed hand baggage limits
